title: Compute runway: SKU availability & timeline (WIP)
content:
Overview:
This is a working runway and availability sheet for GPUs across regions and SKUs. Purpose: estimate weeks-of-runway at current burn, capture committed orders in the procurement pipeline, and highlight regional lead time risks. Status: WIP — fill gaps in committed ETA fields and confirm MOQ details with sourcing.

Key assumptions:
- Weekly tokenized workload -> mapped to GPU hours via model mix (p50).
- Burn expressed in 'GPU-weeks' (1 GPU-week = full 1x GPU used 7d at baseline service mix).
- Committed orders may shift +/- 21 days (sourcing estimate).
- Preferred regions: us-west1, us-east4, europe-west1, apac-sin.
- SKUs represented: A100-80GB, H100-80GB, L40-48GB, A10G-24GB (mix based on model telemetry).

Summary table (current snapshot):
SKU, Region, On-hand (units), Committed (units), Incoming ETA (best), Incoming ETA (worst), Weekly burn (units), Runway (weeks at current burn)
A100-80GB, us-west1, 38, 120, 2026-03-10, 2026-04-05, 9, 6.2
H100-80GB, us-east4, 12, 80, 2026-03-22, 2026-04-15, 16, 0.8
L40-48GB, europe-west1, 72, 0, -, -, 6, 12.0
A10G-24GB, apac-sin, 44, 40, 2026-04-01, 2026-04-20, 10, 4.4
A100-80GB, europe-west1, 20, 0, -, -, 5, 4.0

Notes on table: COMMITTED column includes reserved purchase orders + standing lease options. Some H100s are flagged for dedicated customers (not fungible) — reduce available pool by 30% until allocation finalized.

Runway calculation (logic):
- Runway weeks = (on-hand + expected-arrivals-within-window + fungible-reallocations) / weekly burn.
- Expected-arrivals-within-window counts only 'best' ETA if best <= 21 days from now; otherwise we model as delayed in worst case.
- Fungible-reallocations: estimate of units we can move between regions after deprecations or customer migration (conservative default = 10% of on-hand by SKU).

Order pipeline (open POs & lease options):
- PO# 2026-OR-348 (A100-80GB x40) -> vendor: AlphaAccel, ETA best 2026-03-10, ETA worst 2026-04-05, payment terms net30, destination us-west1.
- LeaseOpt-77 (H100-80GB x50) -> vendor: SiloLease, ETA best 2026-03-22, worst 2026-04-15, note: 30% reserved for Dedicated.
- PO# 2025-OR-299 (A10G-24GB x40) -> vendor: EastCompute, staging ETA 2026-04-01, customs hold risk for apac-sin.
- PO# 2026-OR-400 (L40-48GB x30) -> tentative, awaiting approvals (Finance + Procurement).

Regional lead time notes (qualitative):
- us-west1: historically 7-28 days from order confirmation; vendor backlog currently tolerable but shipping windows narrow around month-end.
- us-east4: international routing issues causing average additional 10 days, customs processing variable. H100 allocations from supplier prioritized to enterprise accounts.
- europe-west1: local stock more available for L40 series; A100 lead times higher due to demand from cloud partners.
- apac-sin: customs and port congestion risk through April; consider air freight if runway < 3 weeks.

Scenarios (quick sensitivity):
1) Optimistic (+0% delay): runway improves by committed arrivals; minimal reallocations needed.
2) Base (+14 day slippage): H100s fall to runway <1 week in us-east4 -> triggers emergency lease/swap.
3) Pessimistic (+30 day slippage + 10% demand spike): multiple SKUs drop under 2-week runway, recommend immediate PO expedite and temporary throttles on non-critical workloads.

Decision triggers / playbook (proposed):
- If any SKU-region runway < 2 weeks -> source emergency lease options (List of preferred partners: SiloLease, TurboBroker).
- If forecasted demand > baseline by +15% for 4 consecutive weeks -> push auto-increment PO to vendor (pre-negotiated option).
- If customs/port delay risk flagged -> convert sea->air for critical POs (cost estimate +2.2x).

Open questions / data gaps:
- Confirm committed PO arrival confirmation numbers for PO# 2026-OR-348 (vendor provided packing list but not carrier AWB).
- MOQ and split-shipment policy from AlphaAccel — can they split 40 into 2 shipments within 3 weeks?
- Which Dedicated customer H100 reservations are cancellable/deferrable? Product team confirmation needed.
- Precise weekly burn mapping across model families (S/Chat/Embed) — infra analytics to provide per-SKU-hour mapping (ticket INFRA-4911).

Action items (owners):
- Aisha: chase AWB for PO# 2026-OR-348, confirm split shipment (due 2026-02-28).
- Marco: validate H100 reserved allocation list with solutions-eng (due 2026-03-03).
- Sofia: update regional customs risk indicator and cost delta for air freight (due 2026-02-27).
- Ethan: run two-week burn reforecast with latest telemetry and upload CSV to linked confluence page (INFRA-4911).

Quick checklist for exec sync:
- Top 3 at-risk SKUs/regions (today): H100@us-east4, A100@us-west1 (if split fails), A10G@apac-sin (customs).
- Recommended immediate ask: approve emergency lease budget cap $1.2M for short window.
- Next update: run weekly until all critical POs hit ports (next update 2026-03-03).

Notes to self (scratch):
- Consider pooling strategy: move older L40 units from europe-west1 to us-east4 if A100/H100 shortage persists and cold-start cost acceptable.
- Confirm with accounting if lease-to-buy options auto-convert after 90 days (some vendors do).
- Add call with AlphaAccel ops to weekly cadence until all POs cleared.

Document history: created 2025-11-04 by Aisha Patel; iterated multiple times after procurement syncs.
